column1: # comment: "Evidence and source-typing alignments. CRMinf: EvidenceClass aligns to I2 Belief (the warranted claim) and I5 Inference Making (the evidential process). PROV-O: CitationAct aligns to prov:Entity; hasEvidenceClass aligns loosely to prov:wasDerivedFrom (PROV-O has no explicit warrant-typing property). schema.org: CitationAct aligns to schema:citation; supportsNotability aligns loosely to schema:Claim (schema:Claim has appearance/evidence facets). WP:GNG: The independent + secondary + significant-coverage triad is conceptual grounding for Axis B; no RDF vocabulary exists. C2PA: digitalSourceType is a loose conceptual match to EvidenceClass; no stable C2PA RDF vocabulary exists."

column6: DataCite relationType is a metadata field, not an ontology class
loose — nanopub RDF exists but the signed-graph pattern is implementation-specific
schema:Claim is a CreativeWork about a claim, not a notability boolean
A citation is an information object that can be derived from, attributed to, and used in provenance traces
A citation references a source that carries propositions; I4 Proposition Set is the set of propositions being argued over

Cross-category relatedness: schema:citation is a flat property on schema:CreativeWork, while gmeow:CitationAct is a reified relator class that carries intent, selector, warrant, and source-typing facets. They occupy the same semantic space (the citation link) but at different levels of reification.
An evidence class describes the warrant/kind of belief held about a claim; CRMinf I2 Belief is the temporal entity representing that belief
gmeow:hasEvidenceClass names the warrant type; J5_holds_to_be is the belief-value predicate (true/probable/possible/false) — related but distinct dimensions
PROV-O wasDerivedFrom links an entity to its source but carries no explicit warrant-typing; gmeow:hasEvidenceClass adds the missing typing layer
schema:isBasedOn links a CreativeWork to its source material; gmeow:hasEvidenceClass types the evidential warrant of that link
